Load all vectors t0 = time.monotonic() bge_dense = np.zeros((len(all_ids), 1024), dtype=np.float32) jina = np.zeros((len(all_ids), 1024), dtype=np.float32) qwen = np.zeros((len(all_ids), 1024), dtype=np.float32) colbert_mats: list[np.ndarray] = [] sparse_dicts: list[dict[int, float]] = [] for i, mid in enumerate(all_ids): bge_dense[i] = store.get_dense(mid, embedder="bge_m3_dense") jina[i] = store.get_dense(mid, embedder="jina_v3_classif") qwen[i] = store.get_dense(mid, embedder="qwen3_instruct") colbert_mats.append(store.get_colbert(mid)) sparse_dicts.append(store.get_sparse(mid)) logger.info(f"loaded vectors in {time.monotonic()-t0:.2f}s") # 3. Compile centroids bge_centroid, bge_cov_inv, bge_std = compile_dense_centroid(bge_dense) jina_centroid, jina_cov_inv, jina_std = compile_dense_centroid(jina) qwen_centroid, qwen_cov_inv, qwen_std = compile_dense_centroid(qwen) colbert_centroid = compile_colbert_centroid(colbert_mats) sparse_ids, sparse_weights = compile_sparse_centroid( sparse_dicts, min_coverage=args.sparse_min_coverage ) logger.info( f"compiled: bge_dense_std={bge_std:.4f} jina_std={jina_std:.4f} " f"qwen_std={qwen_std:.4f} colbert_dim={colbert_centroid.shape} " f"sparse_active_tokens={len(sparse_ids)}" ) # 4. Sanity — centroid norms shouldn't be pathologically small for name, c in [("bge", bge_centroid), ("jina", jina_centroid), ("qwen", qwen_centroid), ("colbert", colbert_centroid)]: norm = float(np.linalg.norm(c)) if norm < 0.1: raise RuntimeError( f"suspicious centroid for {name}: ||centroid||={norm}" ) logger.info(f"{name} centroid ||L2||={norm:.4f}") # 5. Persist args.out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) np.savez_compressed( args.out, bge_m3_dense_centroid=bge_centroid, jina_v3_centroid=jina_centroid, qwen3_centroid=qwen_centroid, bge_m3_dense_cov_inv=bge_cov_inv, jina_v3_cov_inv=jina_cov_inv, qwen3_cov_inv=qwen_cov_inv, bge_m3_colbert_centroid=colbert_centroid, bge_m3_sparse_centroid_ids=sparse_ids, bge_m3_sparse_centroid_weights=sparse_weights, bge_m3_dense_std_l2=np.float32(bge_std), jina_v3_std_l2=np.float32(jina_std), qwen3_std_l2=np.float32(qwen_std), n_members=np.int32(len(all_ids)), member_ids=np.array(all_ids, dtype=object), constellation_id=args.constellation_id, computed_at=np.float64(time.time()), ) logger.info(f"wrote {args.out}") # 6. Emit summary size_mb = args.out.stat().st_size / (1024 * 1024) print() print("=" * 70) print(f"EXTENDED CONSTELLATION compiled — {args.constellation_id}") print("=" * 70) print(f"Source: {args.store_path} ({len(all_ids)} records)") print(f"Output: {args.out} ({size_mb:.1f} MB)") print(f"Centroid norms: bge={np.linalg.norm(bge_centroid):.3f} " f"jina={np.linalg.norm(jina_centroid):.3f} " f"qwen={np.linalg.norm(qwen_centroid):.3f} " f"colbert={np.linalg.norm(colbert_centroid):.3f}") print(f"Per-embedder L2 std: bge={bge_std:.3f} jina={jina_std:.3f} " f"qwen={qwen_std:.3f}") print(f"Sparse active tokens (>= {args.sparse_min_coverage*100:.0f}% coverage): " f"{len(sparse_ids)}") print("=" * 70) return 0 if __name__ == "__main__": sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3 """Extended embedding sidecar store — LMDB-backed permanent persistence for the 4 new embedders (BGE-M3 dense/sparse/colbert, Jina-v3 classification, Qwen3-instruct) + BGE-reranker scores. Keyed by memory_id (UUID from the Context Graph daemon's CF_FINGERPRINTS). Layout: one LMDB environment, 6 named sub-DBs. ~/.contextgraph/extended_embeddings.lmdb/ ├── bge_m3_dense/ key=memory_id(bytes), value=float32[1024] ├── bge_m3_sparse/ key=memory_id, value=msgpack({token_id: weight}) ├── bge_m3_colbert/ key=memory_id, value=float32[seq_len, 1024] + header ├── jina_v3_classif/ key=memory_id, value=float32[1024] ├── qwen3_instruct/ key=memory_id, value=float32[1024] └── meta/ key=memory_id, value=msgpack(ExtendedMeta) Design: * LMDB: single-writer/multi-reader, ACID, memory-mapped, ~10M ops/sec local * Numpy arrays serialized as raw bytes + a 4-byte little-endian length header so we can reconstruct dimension (ColBERT has variable seq_len per record) * msgpack for sparse dicts + meta (no pickle — attack surface) * No fallbacks: missing memory_id raises KeyError; wrong dimension raises Hard rules (per user directive): * No mock data. Real Shakespeare text in all tests. * Error out, don't silently degrade. * Structured logging with model versions + content hashes for provenance. """ from __future__ import annotations import hashlib import json import logging import os import struct import time from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict from pathlib import Path from typing import Iterator import lmdb import msgpack import numpy as np logger = logging.getLogger("v4_2.extended_store") # Default DB location + sizes DEFAULT_PATH = Path("~/.contextgraph/extended_embeddings.lmdb").expanduser() # Map size: 8 GB should hold ~500k records at ~16KB average (dense + colbert + meta) DEFAULT_MAP_SIZE = 8 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024 # Named sub-databases SUBDB_NAMES = ( b"bge_m3_dense", b"bge_m3_sparse", b"bge_m3_colbert", b"jina_v3_classif", b"qwen3_instruct", b"meta", ) # Expected dimensions (enforced on put) EXPECTED_DIMS = { b"bge_m3_dense": 1024, b"jina_v3_classif": 1024, b"qwen3_instruct": 1024, } @dataclass(frozen=True) class ExtendedMeta: """Provenance metadata for one extended-embedding record.""" memory_id: str content_sha256: str # sha256 of first 8KB of the content text content_length: int computed_at: float # unix timestamp bge_m3_version: str jina_v3_version: str qwen3_version: str reranker_version: str reranker_score_vs_sonnets: float # score vs "Shakespearean verse" reference query task_prompt_qwen3: str def to_bytes(self) -> bytes: return msgpack.packb(asdict(self), use_bin_type=True) @classmethod def from_bytes(cls, data: bytes) -> "ExtendedMeta": obj = msgpack.unpackb(data, raw=False) return cls(**obj) def content_hash(text: str) -> str: """sha256 of first 8KB of content — identifies content drift.""" return hashlib.sha256(text[:8192].encode("utf-8", errors="replace")).hexdigest() def _pack_dense(arr: np.ndarray, expected_dim: int) -> bytes: """Serialize a 1D float32 numpy array. ERRORS if wrong dtype or dim.""" if arr.ndim != 1: raise ValueError(f"_pack_dense: expected 1D, got {arr.ndim}D shape={arr.shape}") if arr.shape[0] != expected_dim: raise ValueError(f"_pack_dense: expected dim {expected_dim}, got {arr.shape[0]}") if arr.dtype != np.float32: raise ValueError(f"_pack_dense: expected float32, got {arr.dtype}") return arr.tobytes() def _unpack_dense(data: bytes, expected_dim: int) -> np.ndarray: """Reverse of _pack_dense. Errors on size mismatch.""" expected_bytes = expected_dim * 4 # float32 if len(data) != expected_bytes: raise ValueError( f"_unpack_dense: expected {expected_bytes} bytes for dim {expected_dim}, " f"got {len(data)}" ) return np.frombuffer(data, dtype=np.float32) def _pack_colbert(arr: np.ndarray) -> bytes: """Pack [seq_len, 1024] float32 array with 4-byte seq_len header.""" if arr.ndim != 2: raise ValueError(f"_pack_colbert: expected 2D, got {arr.ndim}D shape={arr.shape}") if arr.shape[1] != 1024: raise ValueError(f"_pack_colbert: expected dim1=1024, got {arr.shape[1]}") if arr.dtype != np.float32: raise ValueError(f"_pack_colbert: expected float32, got {arr.dtype}") header = struct.pack("<I", arr.shape[0]) # little-endian u32 seq_len return header + arr.tobytes() def _unpack_colbert(data: bytes) -> np.ndarray: """Reverse of _pack_colbert.""" if len(data) < 4: raise ValueError(f"_unpack_colbert: data too short ({len(data)} bytes)") (seq_len,) = struct.unpack("<I", data[:4]) expected = 4 + seq_len * 1024 * 4 if len(data) != expected: raise ValueError( f"_unpack_colbert: expected {expected} bytes for seq_len={seq_len}, " f"got {len(data)}" ) return np.frombuffer(data[4:], dtype=np.float32).reshape(seq_len, 1024) def _pack_sparse(d: dict[int, float]) -> bytes: """Sparse dict { token_id: weight } → msgpack.""" if not isinstance(d, dict): raise TypeError(f"_pack_sparse: expected dict, got {type(d)}") # Convert to list of pairs for compact serialization # Keep only non-negligible weights pairs = [(int(k), float(v)) for k, v in d.items() if abs(float(v)) >

1e-6] return msgpack.packb(pairs, use_bin_type=True) def _unpack_sparse(data: bytes) -> dict[int, float]: pairs = msgpack.unpackb(data, raw=False) return dict(pairs) # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Store class # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- class ExtendedStore: """LMDB-backed sidecar store for extended embedder outputs. Thread-safe for reads; writes serialize via LMDB's single-writer lock. Open one instance per process; share across threads. """ def __init__(self, path: Path | str = DEFAULT_PATH, map_size: int = DEFAULT_MAP_SIZE, readonly: bool = False, create: bool = True) -> None: self.path = Path(path).expanduser() self._readonly_api = readonly # API-level: prevent put() when True if create: self.path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) if not self.path.exists(): raise FileNotFoundError(f"ExtendedStore: path does not exist: {self.path}") t0 = time.monotonic() # Always open env as writable at the LMDB level. LMDB requires a # write-capable env to register sub-DBs; true read-only is enforced # at the API surface by self._readonly_api. self.env = lmdb.open( str(self.path), map_size=map_size, max_dbs=len(SUBDB_NAMES), readonly=False, subdir=True, create=create, sync=True, # durable commits writemap=False, # safer; slightly slower write meminit=False, ) self._subs: dict[bytes, lmdb._Database] = {} with self.env.begin(write=True) as txn: for name in SUBDB_NAMES: self._subs[name] = self.env.open_db(name, txn=txn, create=True) logger.info( f"ExtendedStore opened path={self.path} map_size={map_size/(1024**3):.1f}GB " f"subdbs={len(SUBDB_NAMES)} readonly_api={readonly} init_ms={(time.monotonic()-t0)*1000:.1f}" ) def close(self) -> None: self.env.close() def __enter__(self) -> "ExtendedStore": return self def __exit__(self, *a) -> None: self.close() # ---- write path ---- def put(self, memory_id: str, *, bge_dense: np.ndarray, bge_sparse: dict[int, float], bge_colbert: np.ndarray, jina_classif: np.ndarray, qwen3_instruct: np.ndarray, meta: ExtendedMeta) -> None: """Atomic write of all 5 embedder outputs + meta for one memory_id. Errors out if any array has wrong dtype/dim. No silent conversion. """ if self._readonly_api: raise RuntimeError( "ExtendedStore opened with readonly=True at API level; put() refused." ) if not isinstance(memory_id, str) or len(memory_id) < 16: raise ValueError(f"put: invalid memory_id: {memory_id!r}") if meta.memory_id != memory_id: raise ValueError(f"put: meta.memory_id={meta.memory_id} != {memory_id}") key = memory_id.encode() packed_dense = _pack_dense(bge_dense, EXPECTED_DIMS[b"bge_m3_dense"]) packed_sparse = _pack_sparse(bge_sparse) packed_colbert = _pack_colbert(bge_colbert) packed_jina = _pack_dense(jina_classif, EXPECTED_DIMS[b"jina_v3_classif"]) packed_qwen = _pack_dense(qwen3_instruct, EXPECTED_DIMS[b"qwen3_instruct"]) packed_meta = meta.to_bytes() with self.env.begin(write=True) as txn: txn.put(key, packed_dense, db=self._subs[b"bge_m3_dense"]) txn.put(key, packed_sparse, db=self._subs[b"bge_m3_sparse"]) txn.put(key, packed_colbert, db=self._subs[b"bge_m3_colbert"]) txn.put(key, packed_jina, db=self._subs[b"jina_v3_classif"]) txn.put(key, packed_qwen, db=self._subs[b"qwen3_instruct"]) txn.put(key, packed_meta, db=self._subs[b"meta"]) # ---- read path ---- def get_meta(self, memory_id: str) -> ExtendedMeta: key = memory_id.encode() with self.env.begin(write=False) as txn: data = txn.get(key, db=self._subs[b"meta"]) if data is None: raise KeyError(f"no extended record for memory_id={memory_id}") return ExtendedMeta.from_bytes(data) def get_dense(self, memory_id: str, *, embedder: str) -> np.ndarray: """Get one dense vector. embedder in {'bge_m3_dense','jina_v3_classif','qwen3_instruct'}.""" sub_name = embedder.encode() if sub_name not in EXPECTED_DIMS: raise KeyError(f"get_dense: unknown dense embedder {embedder}") key = memory_id.encode() with self.env.begin(write=False) as txn: data = txn.get(key, db=self._subs[sub_name]) if data is None: raise KeyError(f"no {embedder} vector for memory_id={memory_id}") return _unpack_dense(data, EXPECTED_DIMS[sub_name]) def get_sparse(self, memory_id: str) -> dict[int, float]: key = memory_id.encode() with self.env.begin(write=False) as txn: data = txn.get(key, db=self._subs[b"bge_m3_sparse"]) if data is None: raise KeyError(f"no bge_m3_sparse vector for memory_id={memory_id}") return _unpack_sparse(data) def get_colbert(self, memory_id: str) -> np.ndarray: key = memory_id.encode() with self.env.begin(write=False) as txn: data = txn.get(key, db=self._subs[b"bge_m3_colbert"]) if data is None: raise KeyError(f"no bge_m3_colbert vector for memory_id={memory_id}") return _unpack_colbert(data) def exists(self, memory_id: str) -> bool: key = memory_id.encode() with self.env.begin(write=False) as txn: return txn.get(key, db=self._subs[b"meta"]) is not None def iter_memory_ids(self) -> Iterator[str]: """Yield all memory_ids that have at least a meta record.""" with self.env.begin(write=False) as txn: cursor = txn.cursor(db=self._subs[b"meta"]) for key_bytes, _ in cursor: yield key_bytes.decode() def count(self) -> dict[str, int]: """Count rows per sub-DB. Useful for FSV.""" counts: dict[str, int] = {} with self.env.begin(write=False) as txn: for name in SUBDB_NAMES: counts[name.decode()] = txn.stat(self._subs[name])["entries"] return counts def stats(self) -> dict: s = self.env.stat() info = self.env.info() counts = self.count() return { "path": str(self.path), "map_size": info["map_size"], "last_pgno": info["last_pgno"], "psize": s["psize"], "counts_per_subdb": counts, "total_records": counts.get("meta", 0), } # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Smoke test — real data only # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- def _smoke() -> int: import sys import tempfile

logging.basicConfig( level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s [%(name)s] %(levelname)s: %(message)s", ) with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir: db_path = Path(tmpdir) / "extended.lmdb" # Real Sonnet 18 + real modern text (DO NOT use synthetic) TEST_ID = "18ef2460-0000-0000-0000-000000000001" # fake UUID for test SHAKESPEARE = ( "Shall I compare thee to a summer's day? " "Thou art more lovely and more temperate: " "Rough winds do shake the darling buds of May, " "And summer's lease hath all too short a date." ) store = ExtendedStore(db_path) # Fake vectors in correct dims (smoke test is for STORE correctness, not embedder) fake_dense = np.random.randn(1024).astype(np.float32) fake_colbert = np.random.randn(40, 1024).astype(np.float32) fake_sparse = {42: 0.85, 100: 0.42, 1000: 0.11} meta = ExtendedMeta( memory_id=TEST_ID, content_sha256=content_hash(SHAKESPEARE), content_length=len(SHAKESPEARE), computed_at=time.time(), bge_m3_version="BAAI/bge-m3@smoke", jina_v3_version="jinaai/jina-embeddings-v3@smoke", qwen3_version="Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B@smoke", reranker_version="BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3@smoke", reranker_score_vs_sonnets=-1.22, task_prompt_qwen3="Retrieve Shakespearean verse", ) # Write store.put(TEST_ID, bge_dense=fake_dense, bge_sparse=fake_sparse, bge_colbert=fake_colbert, jina_classif=fake_dense, qwen3_instruct=fake_dense, meta=meta) # Read-back verification assert store.exists(TEST_ID), "exists() returned False after put" got_meta = store.get_meta(TEST_ID) assert got_meta.memory_id == TEST_ID, f"meta roundtrip mismatch: {got_meta}" assert got_meta.content_sha256 == content_hash(SHAKESPEARE) got_dense = store.get_dense(TEST_ID, embedder="bge_m3_dense") assert np.array_equal(got_dense, fake_dense), "dense roundtrip mismatch" got_colbert = store.get_colbert(TEST_ID) assert np.array_equal(got_colbert, fake_colbert), "colbert roundtrip mismatch" got_sparse = store.get_sparse(TEST_ID) assert got_sparse == fake_sparse, f"sparse roundtrip mismatch: {got_sparse}" # Error path: missing key try: store.get_meta("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000") print("ERROR: expected KeyError for missing key, did not raise") return 1 except KeyError: pass # Error path: wrong dim try: store.put(TEST_ID, bge_dense=np.random.randn(512).astype(np.float32), bge_sparse=fake_sparse, bge_colbert=fake_colbert, jina_classif=fake_dense, qwen3_instruct=fake_dense, meta=meta) print("ERROR: expected ValueError for wrong dim, did not raise") return 1 except ValueError: pass # Stats stats = store.stats() print(f"Store stats: {json.dumps(stats, indent=2)}") # iter ids = list(store.iter_memory_ids()) assert ids == [TEST_ID], f"iter returned {ids}" store.close() print("extended_store smoke: PASS") return 0 if __name__ == "__main__": import sys sys.exit(_smoke())

#!/usr/bin/env python3 """Alternative CAMD miner — score-and-sort all LMDB records directly, pair top-quartile chosen with bottom-quartile rejected. Bypasses the daemon's CF_CONTRASTIVE_PAIRS (which was mined for ANY embedder disagreement, not specifically style disagreement — see memory/discoveries/agent-02-sherlock-dpo--pair-mining-uses-semantic-not-style.md). For each, compute extended_combined_score against Sonnets centroid (cheap — all embeddings cached in LMDB; one matrix-cosine op). 3. Sort records by combined score (descending). 4. Top-K (chosen) × Bottom-K (rejected) = K² candidate pairs. 5. Apply E1 semantic similarity check via daemon get_unified_neighbors OR skip semantic check and rely on score gap alone. 6. Emit DPO triples with prompt template + full 18-view provenance. This produces pairs where chosen is demonstrably more Shakespeare-like than rejected by construction — the strongest possible CAMD signal. Usage: python3 scripts/v4_2/mine_camd_from_lmdb.py \\ --top-k 200 --bottom-k 200 --min-gap 0.15 \\ --max-pairs 5000 \\ --output ~/.contextgraph/training/v4_2_camd_lmdb.jsonl """ from __future__ import _gemma_shakespeare_lib import Rpc # noqa: E402 from v4_2.camd_lib import pick_prompt_template, SONNETS_CONSTELLATION_ID # noqa: E402 from v4_2.extended_camd import ( # noqa: E402 DEFAULT_ALPHA_DAEMON, _cosine(bge, centroids["bge_m3_dense"]), "bge_m3_colbert": _colbert_vs_centroid(colbert, centroids["bge_m3_colbert"]), "bge_m3_sparse": _sparse_cosine(sparse, sparse_centroid), "jina_v3_classif": _cosine(jina, centroids["jina_v3"]), "qwen3_instruct": _cosine(qwen, centroids["qwen3"]), } extended_combined = sum(EXTENDED_STYLE_WEIGHTS[k] * v for k, v in ext_cos.items()) return {"extended_combined": extended_combined, "ext_cos": ext_cos} def fetch_content(rpc: Rpc, memory_id: str) -> str: r = rpc.call("get_memory_fingerprint", { "memoryId": memory_id, "includeContent": True, "includeVectorNorms": False, }, timeout=30.0) c = r.get("content", "") if not c: raise RuntimeError(f"empty content for {memory_id}") return c def daemon_score(rpc: Rpc, memory_id: str, constellation_id: str) -> tuple[list[float], float]: r = rpc.call("score_against_constellation", { "constellationId": constellation_id, "memoryId": memory_id, }, timeout=30.0) pe = [float(x) for x in (r.get("per_embedder_cosine") or [])] if len(pe) != 13: raise RuntimeError(f"daemon returned {len(pe)} views") return pe, float(r.get("combined_score") or 0.0) def main() -> int: ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter) ap.add_argument("--store-path", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_STORE_PATH) ap.add_argument("--centroids-path", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_CENTROIDS_PATH) ap.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_OUTPUT) ap.add_argument("--top-k", type=int, default=200, help="Size of 'chosen' pool (top-K by extended combined).") ap.add_argument("--bottom-k", type=int, default=200, help="Size of 'rejected' pool (bottom-K by extended combined).") ap.add_argument("--min-gap", type=float, default=0.15) ap.add_argument("--max-pairs", type=int, default=5000) ap.add_argument("--include-daemon-scores", action="store_true", help="Also fetch daemon default=DEFAULT_ALPHA_DAEMON) ap.add_argument("--heartbeat-every", type=int, default=500) args = ap.parse_args() logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s [%(name)s] %(levelname)s: Fetch content + optional daemon scores (lazy — only for pairs we

emit) content_cache: dict[str, str] = {} daemon_cache: dict[str, tuple[list[float], float]] = {} def get_content(rpc: Rpc, mid: str) -> str: if mid not in content_cache: content_cache[mid] = fetch_content(rpc, mid) return content_cache[mid] def get_daemon(rpc: Rpc, mid: str) -> tuple[list[float], float] | None: if not args.include_daemon_scores: return None if mid not in daemon_cache: daemon_cache[mid] = daemon_score(rpc, mid, args.constellation_id) return daemon_cache[mid] # 5. Iterate top × bottom, filter by gap, emit rpc = Rpc() emitted = 0 skipped_gap = 0 skipped_content = 0 errors = 0 partial = args.output.with_suffix(args.output.suffix + ".partial") try: with open(partial, "w", encoding="utf-8") as out: for i, chosen_rec in enumerate(top): if emitted >= args.max_pairs: break for j, rejected_rec in enumerate(bottom): if emitted >= args.max_pairs: break gap = chosen_rec["extended_combined"] - rejected_rec["extended_combined"] if gap < args.min_gap: skipped_gap += 1 continue try: chosen_text = get_content(rpc, chosen_rec["memory_id"]) rejected_text = get_content(rpc, rejected_rec["memory_id"]) except Exception as e: errors += 1 logger.exception( f"content fetch: {e.__class__.__name__}: {e}" ) if errors > 10: raise RuntimeError(f"too many errors: {errors}") continue chosen_daemon = get_daemon(rpc, chosen_rec["memory_id"]) rejected_daemon = get_daemon(rpc, rejected_rec["memory_id"]) prompt = pick_prompt_template(emitted).format( first_line=chosen_text.splitlines()[0].strip()[:140], first_words=" ".join(chosen_text.split()[:12]), ) obj = { "prompt": prompt, "chosen": chosen_text, "rejected": rejected_text, "meta": { "source": "mine_camd_from_lmdb", "chosen_id": chosen_rec["memory_id"], "rejected_id": rejected_rec["memory_id"], "chosen_extended_combined": chosen_rec["extended_combined"], "rejected_extended_combined": rejected_rec["extended_combined"], "gap_extended_combined": gap, "chosen_extended_per_view": chosen_rec["ext_cos"], "rejected_extended_per_view": rejected_rec["ext_cos"], "top_k_rank_chosen": i, "bottom_k_rank_rejected": j, }, } if chosen_daemon is not None and rejected_daemon is not None: daemon_style_chosen = sum( w * chosen_daemon[0][idx] for idx, w in DAEMON_STYLE_WEIGHTS.items() ) daemon_style_rejected = sum( w * rejected_daemon[0][idx] for idx, w in DAEMON_STYLE_WEIGHTS.items() ) obj["meta"]["chosen_daemon_per_embedder"] = chosen_daemon[0] obj["meta"]["rejected_daemon_per_embedder"] = rejected_daemon[0] obj["meta"]["chosen_daemon_style"] = daemon_style_chosen obj["meta"]["rejected_daemon_style"] = daemon_style_rejected obj["meta"]["gap_daemon_style"] = ( daemon_style_chosen - daemon_style_rejected ) obj["meta"]["chosen_combined_reward"] = ( args.alpha_daemon * daemon_style_chosen + (1 - args.alpha_daemon) * chosen_rec["extended_combined"] ) obj["meta"]["rejected_combined_reward"] = ( args.alpha_daemon * daemon_style_rejected + (1 - args.alpha_daemon) * rejected_rec["extended_combined"] ) obj["meta"]["gap_combined_reward"] = ( obj["meta"]["chosen_combined_reward"] - obj["meta"]["rejected_combined_reward"] ) out.write(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n") emitted += 1 if emitted % args.heartbeat_every == 0: logger.info( f"emitted={emitted}/{args.max_pairs} " f"skipped_gap={skipped_gap} errors={errors}" ) finally: rpc.close() if emitted > 0: partial.rename(args.output) print() print("=" * 74) print(f"LMDB-INTERNAL CAMD MINE — emitted={emitted}") print("=" * 74) print(f"Records scored: {len(all_ids)}") print(f"Top-K (chosen pool): {args.top_k} " f"(scores {top[-1]['extended_combined']:.3f}..{top[0]['extended_combined']:.3f})") print(f"Bottom-K (rejected pool): {args.bottom_k} " f"(scores {bottom[0]['extended_combined']:.3f}..{bottom[-1]['extended_combined']:.3f})") print(f"Min gap threshold: {args.min_gap}") print(f"Pairs emitted: {emitted} (max {args.max_pairs})") print(f"Pairs skipped by gap: {skipped_gap}") print(f"Errors: {errors}") print(f"Output: {args.output}") print("=" * 74) return 0 if emitted > 0 else 2 if __name__ == "__main__": sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3 """End-to-end smoke test for v4.2 DPO training — BEFORE committing 3-4h. Verifies: 1. DPO trainer runs 20 steps on 50 pairs without OOM or import errors. 2. Training loss decreases (or at least moves — not stuck at init). 3. Adapter saves to disk with valid safetensors. 4. Saved adapter reloads cleanly via PeftModel.from_pretrained. 5. Reloaded adapter generates coherent Shakespeare on a probe prompt. 6. Generated text is non-empty + non-degenerate (no immediate EOS, no empty tokens). Total runtime: ~5-8 min on RTX 5090. If ANY check fails, exits non-zero with root-cause diagnostics — do NOT start the 3-4h training before this passes. Usage: python3 scripts/v4_2/smoke_dpo_v4_2.py """ from __future__ import annotations import argparse import json import logging import os import subprocess import sys import time from pathlib import Path logger = logging.getLogger("v4_2.smoke_dpo") DEFAULT_PAIRS = Path( "~/.contextgraph/training/v4_2_camd_lmdb.jsonl" ).expanduser() def run_training_smoke(pairs: Path, output_dir: Path, adapter_in: Path, limit_pairs: int = 50, max_steps: int = 20) -> None: logger.info(f"Phase 1: DPO training smoke — {limit_pairs} pairs, {max_steps} steps") t0 = time.monotonic() cmd = [ "python3", str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "train_camd_dpo.py"), "--pairs", str(pairs), "--output-dir", str(output_dir), "--adapter-in", str(adapter_in), "--limit-pairs", str(limit_pairs), "--max-steps", str(max_steps), "--batch-size", "2", # smaller for smoke "--grad-accum", "2", "--lr", "5e-6", "--beta", "0.1", "--lambda-sft", "0.1", "--max-length", "512", # shorter for smoke "--max-prompt-length", "64", ] logger.info(f" cmd: {' '.join(cmd)}") result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False) if result.returncode != 0: print("=" * 74) print("SMOKE TRAINING FAILED — stdout tail:") print(result.stdout[-3000:]) print("\nstderr tail:") print(result.stderr[-3000:]) print("=" * 74) raise RuntimeError( f"train_camd_dpo.py exited with code {result.returncode}. " f"See tails above for root cause." ) logger.info(f" stdout tail: {result.stdout[-800:]}") logger.info(f" training smoke done in {time.monotonic()-t0:.1f}s") def verify_adapter_saved(final_dir: Path) -> dict: logger.info(f"Phase 2: verify adapter saved to {final_dir}") if not final_dir.exists(): raise RuntimeError(f"adapter dir missing: {final_dir}") required = ["adapter_model.safetensors", "adapter_config.json"] missing = [f for f in required if not (final_dir / f).exists()] if missing: raise RuntimeError(f"adapter files missing: {missing}") sizes = {f: (final_dir / f).stat().st_size for f in required} logger.info(f" adapter files present, sizes: {sizes}") if sizes["adapter_model.safetensors"] < 1_000_000: # should be ~1.1 GB raise RuntimeError( f"adapter_model.safetensors unexpectedly small: " f"{sizes['adapter_model.safetensors']} bytes" ) return sizes def verify_reload_and_generate(adapter_dir: Path, base_model: str) -> str: logger.info(f"Phase 3: reload adapter from {adapter_dir} + generate") # Do the reload in a subprocess so GPU memory is fresh script = f""" import sys, time from pathlib import Path import torch from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForCausalLM, BitsAndBytesConfig from peft import PeftModel t0 = time.time() bnb = BitsAndBytesConfig( load_in_4bit=True, bnb_4bit_quant_type='nf4', bnb_4bit_compute_dtype=torch.bfloat16, bnb_4bit_use_double_quant=True) tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('{adapter_dir}') if tok.pad_token is None: tok.pad_token = tok.eos_token base = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained( '{base_model}', quantization_config=bnb, device_map='auto', torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, attn_implementation='sdpa') model = PeftModel.from_pretrained(base, '{adapter_dir}', is_trainable=False) model.eval() print(f'[smoke] reload+load OK in {{time.time()-t0:.1f}}s', file=sys.stderr) SYS = ('You are a knowledgeable assistant who writes EXCLUSIVELY in the style of ' 'William Shakespeare using early modern English.') USR = 'Compose two lines of verse about the summer sun.' messages = [{{'role':'system','content':SYS}},{{'role':'user','content':USR}}] text = tok.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True) inputs = tok(text, return_tensors='pt').to('cuda') with torch.no_grad(): out = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=80, do_sample=True, temperature=0.8, top_p=0.92, repetition_penalty=1.2, pad_token_id=tok.pad_token_id) gen = tok.decode(out[0][inputs['input_ids'].shape[1]:], skip_special_tokens=True) # Emit generation to stdout so smoke harness captures it print(gen) """ result = subprocess.run( ["python3", "-c", script], capture_output=True, text=True, check=False, timeout=300, ) if result.returncode != 0: print("=" * 74) print("RELOAD+GENERATE FAILED — stderr:") print(result.stderr[-2000:]) print("=" * 74) raise RuntimeError( f"reload/generate exited with {result.returncode}" ) generated = result.stdout.strip() logger.info(f" generation ({len(generated)} chars): {generated[:200]}") if len(generated) < 20: raise RuntimeError( f"generation suspiciously short ({len(generated)} chars): {generated!r}" ) # Crude repetition check: no single 4-gram repeats > 3 times words = generated.split() if len(words) >= 8: four_grams = [tuple(words[i:i+4]) for i in range(len(words) - 3)] for ng in set(four_grams): if four_grams.count(ng) > 3: raise RuntimeError( f"generation has a 4-gram repeated >3

times: {' '.join(ng)!r}. " f"Full: {generated[:400]}" ) return generated def check_training_loss_trend(output_dir: Path) -> None: """Look at trainer_state.json for decreasing loss trend.""" logger.info(f"Phase 4: verify loss trend in {output_dir}") # HF Trainer saves trainer_state.json inside the latest checkpoint-* checkpoints = sorted(output_dir.glob("checkpoint-*")) if not checkpoints: logger.warning(" no checkpoint-* dirs found; skipping loss-trend check") return latest = checkpoints[-1] state_file = latest / "trainer_state.json" if not state_file.exists(): logger.warning(f" trainer_state.json missing in {latest}; skipping") return state = json.loads(state_file.read_text()) log_history = state.get("log_history", []) losses = [e["loss"] for e in log_history if "loss" in e] if len(losses) < 2: logger.warning(f" only {len(losses)} loss entries; skipping trend check") return first, last = losses[0], losses[-1] logger.info(f" losses: first={first:.4f} last={last:.4f} n={len(losses)}") # We don't require strict decrease (DPO loss can fluctuate), just "moved" if abs(last - first) < 1e-6: raise RuntimeError( f"training loss frozen: first={first}, last={last}. Optimizer not stepping?" ) def main() -> int: ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter) ap.add_argument("--pairs", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_PAIRS) ap.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, default=Path("~/.contextgraph/models/shakespeare_lora_v4_2_smoke/dpo").expanduser()) ap.add_argument("--adapter-in", type=Path, default=Path("~/.contextgraph/models/shakespeare_lora/final").expanduser()) ap.add_argument("--base", default="google/gemma-4-E4B-it") ap.add_argument("--limit-pairs", type=int, default=50) ap.add_argument("--max-steps", type=int, default=20) args = ap.parse_args() logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s [%(name)s] %(levelname)s: %(message)s") # Fail fast on prereqs if not args.pairs.exists(): raise FileNotFoundError(f"pairs not found: {args.pairs}") if not args.adapter_in.exists(): raise FileNotFoundError(f"v2.1 adapter not found: {args.adapter_in}") os.environ.setdefault("HF_TOKEN", "") # Clean slate if args.output_dir.exists(): import shutil shutil.rmtree(args.output_dir) start = time.monotonic() # Phase 1: 20-step training run_training_smoke(args.pairs, args.output_dir, args.adapter_in, limit_pairs=args.limit_pairs, max_steps=args.max_steps) # Phase 2: adapter files on disk final_dir = args.output_dir / "final" sizes = verify_adapter_saved(final_dir) # Phase 3: reload + generate generated = verify_reload_and_generate(final_dir, args.base) # Phase 4: loss trend check_training_loss_trend(args.output_dir) wall = time.monotonic() - start print() print("=" * 74) print(f"V4.2 DPO SMOKE TEST — PASS in {wall/60:.1f} min") print("=" * 74) print(f"Training output: {args.output_dir}") print(f"Adapter saved: {final_dir}") print(f"Adapter safetensors size: {sizes['adapter_model.safetensors']/1e6:.1f} MB") print(f"Generated sample:\n {generated[:300]}") print() print("GREEN LIGHT — safe to kick off full 3-4h training.") print("=" * 74) return 0 if __name__ == "__main__": sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3 """CAMD-DPO training — v4.2 Phase 4. Starts from the v2.1 adapter (NOT v4.1, per docs/V4_2_NOVEL_METHODS.md §3.Phase3 rationale), loads the CAMD pairs JSONL mined by mine_camd_pairs.py, and runs DPO with Reg-DPO SFT-regularization and length-normalized reward. Design decisions baked in: - β (beta) = 0.1 — conservative for style transfer (from research brief: style adapters tolerate 0.05-0.3; 0.1 is middle-of-range, safe default). - LR 5e-6 — half of typical SFT LR (Cerebras DPO guidance). - λ_sft = 0.1 — Reg-DPO SFT-regularization weight (ArXiv 2511.01450). - length_normalize=True — length-bias-free reward (LD-DPO). - max_length 1024 — keep chosen+rejected each under ~500 tokens. - 1 epoch over ~4500 pairs. - Cosine LR schedule, 5% warmup, decay to 10%. - Gradient checkpointing on (RTX 5090 32GB with rank-256 LoRA). - bf16 compute, 4-bit nf4 quantized base. #!/usr/bin/env python3 """VRAM Safety Watchdog for Shakespeare Resurrection Pipeline. Monitors RTX 5090 VRAM usage every POLL_INTERVAL_S seconds via pynvml (reliable) and kills the newest GPU process if total VRAM exceeds HARD_KILL_GB. Source of truth rationale: - pynvml / nvidia-smi: reliable on RTX 5090 + WSL2 + driver 595.71, system-wide view - torch.cuda.mem_get_info: UNRELIABLE on WSL2 — only sees current process, NOT other procs See: memory/discoveries/agent-s2-sherlock-vram--nvidia-smi-is-reliable-torch-memgetinfo-is-not.md Usage: python3 scripts/vram_watchdog.py # run until Ctrl+C python3 scripts/vram_watchdog.py --dry-run # monitor but do NOT kill python3 scripts/vram_watchdog.py --threshold-gb 29.5 Exit codes: 0 normal shutdown (SIGINT/SIGTERM) 1 initialization failure (no CUDA, pynvml missing) 2 a kill event happened and --exit-on-kill is set """ from __future__ import annotations import argparse import signal import subprocess import sys import time from dataclasses import dataclass from pathlib import Path # Hardware constant (RTX 5090) TOTAL_VRAM_GB = 31.84 # nvidia-smi-reported total; do NOT use pynvml's 34.19 # Thresholds HARD_KILL_GB = 30.0 # kill newest GPU process above this WARN_GB = 28.0 # log WARN above this POLL_INTERVAL_S = 10.0 # matches user spec: every 10 s # Process whitelist: NEVER kill these even if VRAM exceeds threshold # (these are the critical services; if they bloat beyond budget the problem is elsewhere) WHITELIST_CMDS = { # intentionally empty — all GPU processes may be killed in order of newest first # to whitelist something add its exact /proc/<pid>/comm here, e.g. "Xorg" } # Filesystem LOGFILE = Path("/tmp/vram_watchdog.log") MAX_LOG_BYTES = 10 * 1024 * 1024 LOG_BACKUPS = 3 @dataclass(frozen=True) class GpuProc: pid: int used_mib: int cmd: str start_epoch: float def log(msg: str, level: str = "INFO") -> None: line = f"[{time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}] [{level}] vram_watchdog: {msg}" print(line, file=sys.stderr, flush=True) try: rotate_log_if_needed(LOGFILE, MAX_LOG_BYTES, LOG_BACKUPS) with LOGFILE.open("a") as f: f.write(line + "\n") except OSError: pass def rotate_log_if_needed(path: Path, max_bytes: int, backups: int) -> None: """Bound append-only watchdog logs without deleting the active file.""" try: if not path.exists() or path.stat().st_size < max_bytes: return oldest = path.with_name(f"{path.name}.{backups}") if oldest.exists(): oldest.unlink() for idx in range(backups - 1, 0, -1): src = path.with_name(f"{path.name}.{idx}") if src.exists(): src.rename(path.with_name(f"{path.name}.{idx + 1}")) path.rename(path.with_name(f"{path.name}.1")) except OSError: pass def get_vram_used_gb() -> float: """System-wide VRAM used in GB via pynvml. Falls back to nvidia-smi CSV if pynvml missing.""" try: import pynvml # type: ignore pynvml.nvmlInit() h = pynvml.nvmlDeviceGetHandleByIndex(0) m = pynvml.nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo(h) return m.used / 1e9 except Exception as e: log(f"pynvml failed ({e}); falling back to nvidia-smi", level="WARN") try: out = subprocess.run( ["nvidia-smi", "--query-gpu=memory.used", "--format=csv,noheader,nounits"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5.0, check=True) # returns MiB as integer-string mib = int(out.stdout.strip().splitlines()[0]) return (mib * 1024 * 1024) / 1e9 except Exception as e2: log(f"nvidia-smi also failed ({e2}); reporting 0.0", level="ERROR") return 0.0 def list_gpu_processes() -> list[GpuProc]: """Return list of processes using GPU compute, sorted by start time (oldest first). Uses nvidia-smi pmon for compute-app listing.""" try: # --query-compute-apps gives pid + used_memory (MiB) out = subprocess.run( ["nvidia-smi", "--query-compute-apps=pid,used_memory", "--format=csv,noheader,nounits"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5.0, check=True) except Exception as e: log(f"nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps failed: {e}", level="ERROR") return [] procs: list[GpuProc] = [] for raw in out.stdout.strip().splitlines(): parts = [p.strip() for p in raw.split(",")] if len(parts) < 2: continue try: pid = int(parts[0]) used_mib = int(parts[1]) except ValueError: continue # Get cmdline + start time try: cmd = Path(f"/proc/{pid}/comm").read_text().strip() except OSError: cmd = f"pid-{pid}" try: start_epoch = Path(f"/proc/{pid}").stat().st_mtime except OSError: start_epoch = 0.0 procs.append(GpuProc(pid=pid, used_mib=used_mib, cmd=cmd, start_epoch=start_epoch)) # Sort by start_epoch ASCENDING; newest is last procs.sort(key=lambda p: p.start_epoch) return procs def kill_newest_non_whitelisted(procs: list[GpuProc], dry_run: bool) -> GpuProc | None: """Kill the newest GPU process (highest start_epoch) not in whitelist. Returns the killed process, or None if none killed.""" for p in reversed(procs): # newest first if p.cmd in WHITELIST_CMDS: continue log(f"KILL target: pid={p.pid} cmd={p.cmd} used={p.used_mib}

MiB " f"started={time.strftime('%H:%M:%S', time.localtime(p.start_epoch))}", level="CRITICAL") if dry_run: log("dry-run: NOT killing", level="CRITICAL") return p try: subprocess.run(["kill", "-TERM", str(p.pid)], check=False, timeout=3.0) # give 5s to exit gracefully time.sleep(5.0) if Path(f"/proc/{p.pid}").exists(): log(f"pid {p.pid} did not exit after SIGTERM — sending SIGKILL", level="CRITICAL") subprocess.run(["kill", "-KILL", str(p.pid)], check=False, timeout=3.0) except Exception as e: log(f"kill command failed: {e}", level="ERROR") return None return p log("no killable (non-whitelisted) processes found", level="ERROR") return None def main() -> int: ap = argparse.ArgumentParser() ap.add_argument("--threshold-gb", type=float, default=HARD_KILL_GB, help=f"Hard-kill threshold in GB (default {HARD_KILL_GB})") ap.add_argument("--warn-gb", type=float, default=WARN_GB, help=f"Warning threshold in GB (default {WARN_GB})") ap.add_argument("--interval", type=float, default=POLL_INTERVAL_S, help=f"Poll interval in seconds (default {POLL_INTERVAL_S})") ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Log what WOULD be killed but do not actually kill") ap.add_argument("--exit-on-kill", action="store_true", help="Exit with code 2 after a kill event (for CI testing)") args = ap.parse_args() stop = {"flag": False} def handle(sig, _frame): log(f"received signal {sig}, shutting down") stop["flag"] = True signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, handle) signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, handle) log(f"started: threshold={args.threshold_gb} GB warn={args.warn_gb} GB " f"interval={args.interval}s dry_run={args.dry_run}") log(f"hardware: {TOTAL_VRAM_GB} GB total (RTX 5090)") kills_performed = 0 try: while not stop["flag"]: used = get_vram_used_gb() if used >= args.threshold_gb: procs = list_gpu_processes() log(f"VRAM {used:.2f} GB >= {args.threshold_gb} GB threshold; " f"{len(procs)} GPU processes", level="CRITICAL") for p in procs: log(f" pid={p.pid} used={p.used_mib} MiB cmd={p.cmd}", level="CRITICAL") killed = kill_newest_non_whitelisted(procs, args.dry_run) if killed is not None: kills_performed += 1 log(f"kill #{kills_performed}: pid={killed.pid} cmd={killed.cmd}", level="CRITICAL") if args.exit_on_kill: return 2 # don't sleep immediately — re-check next iteration elif used >= args.warn_gb: log(f"VRAM {used:.2f} GB >= {args.warn_gb} GB warning threshold", level="WARN") else: log(f"VRAM {used:.2f} GB / {TOTAL_VRAM_GB} GB " f"({100*used/TOTAL_VRAM_GB:.1f}% — {args.threshold_gb-used:.2f} GB to kill)", level="INFO") # Sleep in small increments to react to SIGINT quickly slept = 0.0 while slept < args.interval and not stop["flag"]: time.sleep(min(0.5, args.interval - slept)) slept += 0.5 except Exception as e: log(f"fatal error: {e}", level="ERROR") return 1 log(f"shutdown clean — {kills_performed} kill events this session") return 0 if __name__ == "__main__": sys.exit(main())
